scripts.typecheck: pnpm build && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && pnpm --filter @qualigence/web-console run typecheck
scripts.gate:companion: cargo fmt --manifest-path apps/companion/Cargo.toml --check && cargo build --manifest-path apps/companion/Cargo.toml && cargo test --manifest-path apps/companion/Cargo.toml
scripts.gate:fast: pnpm typecheck && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts run --gate gate-fast --report .gate-evidence/gate-fast/report.json --selection tests/unit --selection tests/replay --selection tests/migration --selection tests/property --selection tests/smoke -- pnpm vitest run tests/unit tests/replay tests/migration tests/property tests/smoke && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts accept --report .gate-evidence/gate-fast/report.json --marker .gate-evidence/gate-fast/accepted.json
scripts.gate:linux: node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/infrastructure-preflight.ts chromium openssl && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts run --gate gate-linux --report .gate-evidence/gate-linux/report.json --selection tests/e2e/web-console --selection tests/e2e/web-execution -- pnpm vitest run tests/e2e/web-console tests/e2e/web-execution && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts accept --report .gate-evidence/gate-linux/report.json --marker .gate-evidence/gate-linux/accepted.json
scripts.gate:windows: node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/infrastructure-preflight.ts windows11 chromium cargo openssl && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts run --gate gate-windows-rust --report .gate-evidence/gate-windows-rust/report.json --selection tests/e2e/windows/companion-client.test.ts --selection tests/e2e/windows/desktop-runner.test.ts --selection tests/e2e/windows/named-pipe-authority.test.ts --selection tests/contract/desktop --selection tests/component/windows-uia --selection tests/replay/windows-uia --selection tests/conformance/observation/windows-uia.test.ts -- pnpm vitest run tests/e2e/windows/companion-client.test.ts tests/e2e/windows/desktop-runner.test.ts tests/e2e/windows/named-pipe-authority.test.ts tests/contract/desktop tests/component/windows-uia tests/replay/windows-uia tests/conformance/observation/windows-uia.test.ts && pnpm gate:companion && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts accept --report .gate-evidence/gate-windows-rust/report.json --marker .gate-evidence/gate-windows-rust/accepted.json
scripts.gate:self-hosted: node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/infrastructure-preflight.ts docker && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts run --gate gate-self-hosted --report .gate-evidence/gate-self-hosted/report.json --selection tests/e2e/self-hosted -- pnpm vitest run tests/e2e/self-hosted && node --experimental-strip-types tests/helpers/gate-evidence.ts accept --report .gate-evidence/gate-self-hosted/report.json --marker .gate-evidence/gate-self-hosted/accepted.json
scripts.benchmark:detection: pnpm build && node apps/benchmark-runner/dist/main.js run --manifest benchmarks/detection-v1
